deathSays.line: The keeper of Thornfield's codex watches you copy the final page. "You're the first outsider to read it all," they say quietly. "Our dead wrote some of that. Carry it well."

Rich striped meat — cook it hard; this is the System's cut, not nature's. The fat burns long in a lamp. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"

🕯️ Blanca is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Blanca Cox is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Blanca kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
Boiled 3L. Bacteria dead. (-45 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
That night, they bring Blanca home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⬢ SYSTEM: "One clarification, scholar: linking codices sharpens MY eyes. Ability slots grow from YOUR neural integration — 24/100, holding 2 slots (next at 40). Discover, practice, survive — let the interface learn you."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
